source_snapshot.working_master: Ad Orientem — Sacred Places Reconciled Master — 2026-10-28

rules: P49 150 IDs and review ordering are frozen; no source or geometry inferred as freshly verified simply by copying historic URL.
Exact canonical Place reuse is a research crosswalk proposal, not automatically a changed published registry or authoritative reduction in the P48 unresolved 364 count.

Do not merge an Orthodox, Anglican, Lutheran, secularized or ruin site into the active Catholic physical-worship category. Historically Catholic places may be routed to separately typed heritage research.

Names alone and nearby OSM features cannot identify a physical Catholic church; never merge Oura Cathedral with Nagasaki martyr shrine, Saint Thomas Malayattoor with Chennai, St John Ein Karem with Visitation, or Gate of Dawn chapel with entire gatehouse.
P50 proposed features remain unmerged. PR 1737 fails App Convergence phone Mass Reader; it is unrelated to geography contracts and must be repaired without weakening acceptance tests.
All publication_authorized statuses remain NO; no map pins, typed source registry, app runtime or Mass times are modified.
